processing.normalization: One full three-phase master; contiguous sample cuts; slices never independently normalized

tracks.script: 头上那条弯弯的东西，你看见了吗？我们去认识副栉龙。先记住它的头冠，等会儿走近了，你还能一眼认出它吗？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 我们慢慢换个方向看。头冠从脑袋上向后伸，再看看它和大身体的位置。刚才那条弯弯的轮廓，你还认得吗？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 现在用你的眼睛看副栉龙啦。眼前这只从嘴尖到尾巴大约九米半，头冠只占小小一段。慢慢转向旁边，再找找尾巴伸到了哪里。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Can you see that curve on its head? We are going to meet Parasaurolophus. Remember the shape of its crest. Will you recognise it when we get closer?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: As our view changes, find the crest again. It reaches back from the head. Can you recognise its curved outline above that much bigger body?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Now you can look from your own eye level. This Parasaurolophus is about nine and a half metres from snout to tail. Its crest is just one small part. Turn slowly and find where the tail ends.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 异齿龙背上像竖着一把大扇子。我们去看看吧！眼前这只从嘴尖到尾巴约三米，先猜猜，帆顶会到你身体的哪里？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 慢慢靠近，先看贴近地面的身体，再把目光往上移。背帆的顶端，在脑袋上方好高的地方。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 找到它的脸了吗？小脸在背帆前面，四条腿撑着低低的身体。看看它的眼睛，再看看帆顶，和你刚才猜的一样吗？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Dimetrodon looks as if it has a big fan standing on its back. Let’s have a look! This one is about three metres from snout to tail. Where do you think the top of its sail will reach beside you?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: As we get closer, look at its low body first. Then move your eyes upward. The top of the sail rises well above its head.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Have you found its face? The face is in front of the sail, and four short legs support its low body. Look at its eyes, then up at the sail. Does it reach where you guessed?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 这位长腿朋友叫似鸡龙。它从嘴尖到尾巴约六米，脑袋却只有小小一团。我们走近一些，看看长腿上面还连着多长的脖子。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 先找到两只脚，再沿着腿慢慢往上看。别停在身体那里，小脑袋还在细细的脖子上呢。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 抬头找到小脑袋了吗？再把目光放回腿上。摸摸自己的膝盖，再看看似鸡龙的腿，大家都有两条腿，样子可差好多。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Meet Gallimimus, our long-legged neighbour. This one is about six metres from snout to tail, with such a small head. Let’s get closer and see how far its neck reaches above those legs.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Find its two feet and follow the legs upward. Keep looking beyond the body. There is the little head, at the end of that slender neck.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Have you looked up and found its little head? Now look back at the legs. Touch your own knees, then look at Gallimimus’s legs. Two legs each, but such different shapes!
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 甲龙背上一块一块的骨甲，像件厚外套。我们去看看这副宽宽的身体吧。小脑袋和大尾巴，你想先找哪一头？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 我们慢慢走近。先留意低低的脑袋，再看看背上的骨甲。尾巴末端还有一块鼓起来的尾锤。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 眼前这只甲龙从头到尾约八米，身体低低宽宽的。你能从这一侧找到尾锤吗？慢慢绕过去看看，尾锤和前面那段尾巴有什么不同？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: The bony plates on Ankylosaurus look like a thick coat. Let’s inspect that broad body. Which end will you find first, the little head or the tail?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: We move closer. Notice the low head, then the bony armour on its back. There is a swollen club at the end of the tail too.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: This Ankylosaurus is about eight metres from head to tail, with a low, broad body. Can you find the tail club from this side? Move around slowly and compare it with the rest of the tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 蓝色海水里有个小脑袋，后面连着好长一段脖子。戴好潜水装备，我们去看看冥河龙。眼前这只从头到尾快十一米。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 轻轻摆动脚蹼，我们慢慢靠近。先找到小脑袋，再顺着脖子看回身体，找找两侧的大鳍。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 从这里看，小脑袋后面还连着这么大一副身体。慢慢转一转，试着找齐它的四只大鳍。你想先往哪边看？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: There is a little head in the blue water, with a very long neck behind it. Put on your diving gear and meet Styxosaurus. This one is nearly eleven metres from head to tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Kick your fins gently as we move closer. Find the little head, follow the neck back to the body, and look for the big flippers at its sides.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: From here, you can see how much body follows that little head. Move around slowly and try to find all four flippers. Which side would you like to look at first?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 先看看这条大鲸鱼的全身。梅氏利维坦鲸从头到尾大约十三米半，后面的尾巴离脑袋好远。戴好潜水面镜，我们过去看看。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 慢慢靠近，先记住整个轮廓，再把目光放到大脑袋上。两侧的鳍也能帮你认清它的身体。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 从你的眼睛看，大脑袋是不是显得更大了？慢慢转一转，再把尾巴找出来。刚才一眼看完的大鲸鱼，近看要一点一点看。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Take a look at the whole whale first. This Livyatan is about thirteen and a half metres from head to tail. Its tail is a long way behind its head. Diving mask on. Let’s go and look.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: As we move closer, remember the whole outline. Then look at that big head. The flippers at its sides help you find your way along the body.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Does its head seem even bigger from your eye level? Turn slowly and find the tail again. We could see the whole whale from farther away. Up close, we can explore one part at a time.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 伸出一只手，我们去和异特龙比比手指。眼前这只从鼻尖到尾巴快十米，大身体前面有两只小手。一只手有几根手指呢？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 我们慢慢走近，先找身体前面的小手。看清手指以后，再抬头找眼睛上方的小突起。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 找到小手了吗？一根、两根、三根，一只手上有三根手指。你的手呢？再看看它的大脚，小手和大脚的大小差得真多。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Hold up one hand. Let’s compare fingers with Allosaurus. This one is nearly ten metres from snout to tail, with two small hands in front. How many fingers are on one hand?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: We move closer and look for the hands in front of its body. After the fingers, look higher for the small bumps above its eyes.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Have you found a hand? One, two, three. Three fingers on each hand. What about your hand? Now find its big feet. Such a difference between those little hands and big feet!
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 我们下水去找剑射鱼。它和小鱼缸里的鱼，个头差好多！先找找它身体两边的鳍，等会儿近看，还能发现别的小鳍吗？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 面镜戴好，脚蹼轻轻摆。我们靠近一些，看看身体两侧的小鳍，再沿着身体找到尾巴。
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 眼前这条剑射鱼从嘴尖到尾巴大约五米半。找一找，肚子附近也有小鳍。它们轻轻摆的时候，你会先注意到小鳍，还是后面的大尾巴？
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Let’s dive down to find Xiphactinus. It is so much bigger than a little fish in a tank! Find the fins at its sides. Will you spot any smaller fins when we get closer?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: Mask on, and kick your fins gently. We move closer to look at the side fins, then follow the body all the way to the tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: This Xiphactinus is about five and a half metres from snout to tail. Look for the little fins near its belly too. As they move gently, which catches your eye first, a little fin or the big tail behind?
tracks.speaker: Serena
tracks.approvalScope: Owner confirmed current72-track narration batch; no science/visual/production approval implied.

tracks.script: 准备好了吗，小探险家？背上小背包，沿着白垩纪的河边空地，去找一只帝王角龙。它从头到尾大约五米长，你会站到它身体的哪里呢？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 放轻脚步，帝王角龙就在前面。先找四条结实的腿，再往上看，它头后的大颈盾已经露出来了。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 看，它就在对面！大颈盾像一顶王冠，鼻子上的角比眼睛上方的角更长。站在旁边，感受一下五米有多长吧。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Pack your day bag and follow a Cretaceous riverbank in search of a Regaliceratops about five metres from beak to tail. How far up its side will you reach?
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Step softly. Regaliceratops is just ahead. Find its four sturdy legs, then look up at the great frill behind its head.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: There it is across from us! The frill looks like a crown, and its nose horn is larger than the little horns above its eyes. Stand beside it and see how long five metres feels.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 小朋友，我们来到白垩纪的一片空地，去找帝鳄。眼前这只复原的帝鳄，从头到尾大约九米长。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 我们在空地边停下来，安静地看着前方。先找低低的身体，再顺着背上的骨甲，看看伸向后面的长尾巴。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 看，帝鳄就在对面！长嘴和长尾向两头伸开，九米说的是从嘴尖一直到尾巴的长度。看看你的身影，再看看它占了多长的一段空地。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? We have reached a Cretaceous clearing to look for Sarcosuchus. This reconstruction is about nine metres from snout to tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Stay at the edge of the clearing and look ahead. Find its low body, then follow the rows of armour towards the long tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: There it is across from us! Its long snout and tail reach out in opposite directions. Nine metres is the length from one end to the other. Look at your own outline, then see how much ground it covers.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 小朋友，准备好了吗？穿好飞行装备，我们来到侏罗纪岛屿上方，去找蛙嘴翼龙。这次按约三十五厘米的翼展，和你比一比。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 张开双臂，轻轻向前滑翔。看，蛙嘴翼龙出现在前方，宽宽的小脸也看清楚了。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 它来到对面啦！从一边翼尖到另一边，大约三十五厘米。把你的双臂张开，看看谁伸得更宽？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Put on your flying gear and soar above Jurassic islands to find Anurognathus. We will compare you with a wingspan of about thirty-five centimetres.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Spread your arms and glide gently forward. Look, Anurognathus is just ahead, and its little, wide face is coming into view.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: It is right across from us! Its wings stretch about thirty-five centimetres from tip to tip. Open your arms and see which of you is wider.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 准备好了吗，小探险家？背上小背包，走进白垩纪的河边林地，去找一只镰刀龙。它从头到尾大约十米长，长长的爪子会藏在哪里呢？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 沿着空地慢慢往前走，镰刀龙就在前面。先找支撑身体的两条腿，再看看身体前面的两只手。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 找到啦！镰刀龙的手上长着又细又长的爪子，长脖子把小脑袋托得高高的。站在旁边，你要抬多高才能看见它的脸呢？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Pack your day bag and enter a Cretaceous riverside woodland in search of Therizinosaurus. It was about ten metres from head to tail. Where could those long claws be?
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Walk slowly towards the clearing. Therizinosaurus is just ahead. Find the two legs supporting its body, then look at the two hands in front.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: We found it! Long, slender claws reach from its hands, and a long neck holds its small head high above. Stand beside it and see how far up you need to look to find its face.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 准备好了吗，小探险家？背上小背包，去中新世的南美洲找骇鸟。我们要见的这只骇鸟，抬头时大约两米四高，你会和它的哪里一样高呢？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 慢慢走到灌木旁的空地，骇鸟就在前面。先找踩在地上的两只大脚，再沿着长腿往上看。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 看，它就在对面！大嘴巴的尖端向下弯，两只小翅膀长在身体两侧。站在旁边，你的头顶能到它的哪里呢？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Pack your day bag and visit Miocene South America in search of Phorusrhacos. The bird we are meeting is shown about 2.4 metres tall with its head raised. How high will you reach beside it?
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Walk slowly into the clearing beside the shrubs. Phorusrhacos is just ahead. Find its two great feet on the ground, then follow the long legs upward.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: There it is across from us! Its large beak curves down at the tip, and it has two small wings at its sides. Stand beside it and see where the top of your head would reach.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 跟着长尾巴的小翼龙出发吧！穿好飞行装备，我们去侏罗纪的天空里，找一找索德斯翼龙。它展开翅膀，大约有六十厘米宽。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 张开双臂，轻轻向前滑翔。索德斯翼龙就在前面，看看它长长的尾巴和舒展开的皮膜翅膀。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 靠近啦！从一边翼尖到另一边，大约六十厘米。再瞧瞧它身上毛一样的细丝，然后张开双臂，和它比一比谁更宽。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Follow the little pterosaur with the long tail! Put on your flying gear and join Sordes in a Jurassic sky. Its open wings are about sixty centimetres wide.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Spread your arms and glide gently forward. Sordes is just ahead, with its long tail trailing behind its membrane wings.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Here it is! From one wingtip to the other, it measures about sixty centimetres. See the hair-like threads on its body, then open your arms and compare.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 穿好飞行装备，去找风神翼龙吧！它展开翅膀，大约有十米宽。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 张开双臂，稳稳向前滑翔。风神翼龙就在前方，先找它的长脖子，再看看两边的大翅膀。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 看，它来到对面啦！从一边翼尖到另一边，大约十米。你的双臂在它的大翅膀旁边，显得小小的。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Put on your flying gear and soar above a Cretaceous river to find Quetzalcoatlus. We will use a wingspan of about ten metres, based on a giant Quetzalcoatlus.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Spread your arms and glide gently forward. Quetzalcoatlus is just ahead. Find its long neck, then look at the great wings on either side.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: There it is, right across from us! Its wings stretch about ten metres from tip to tip. Your outstretched arms look tiny beside those great wings.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 小朋友，戴好潜水装备，我们潜进白垩纪的近海，去找达拉斯蜥蜴。它从头到尾大约一米长，和大沧龙比起来小多啦。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 轻轻摆动脚蹼，停在能看清它的地方。达拉斯蜥蜴就在前面，先找身体两旁的四条小腿，再看看小脚趾。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 看，它的长尾巴伸到身后啦！从嘴尖到尾巴约一米长，你的手臂能张得这么宽吗？再看看它的小腿，和大沧龙的鳍一样吗？
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Put on your diving gear and visit the waters near a Cretaceous coast in search of Dallasaurus. At about one metre from head to tail, it is small for a mosasaur.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Kick your fins gently and stop where we can see it clearly. Dallasaurus is just ahead. Find its four little legs, then look for the toes.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Look, its long tail stretches behind! Its head-to-tail length is about one metre. Can you spread your arms that wide? Look at those little legs again. Do they look like the flippers of a great mosasaur?
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 小朋友，戴好潜水装备，我们潜进侏罗纪的海洋，去找达科龙。眼前这只复原的达科龙，从头到尾将近五米长。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 轻轻摆动脚蹼，停在安全的位置。先看身体两边的四只鳍状肢，再顺着身体，找找带着尾鳍的长尾巴。
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: 它就在对面啦！四只鳍状肢像小桨，尾巴后面也带着鳍。先看你的身影，再找它的头和尾，原来海里的鳄类亲戚这么长！
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Ready, explorer? Put on your diving gear and enter a Jurassic sea in search of Dakosaurus. This reconstruction is nearly five metres from head to tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: Kick your fins gently and stay in our safe spot. Find the four flippers along its sides, then follow its body to the finned tail.
tracks.speaker: Serena

tracks.script: It is right across from us! Its four flippers look like little paddles, and its tail has a fin too. Look at your own outline, then find its head and tail. What a long sea-going crocodile relative!
tracks.speaker: Serena
